title: mcpconform consumer profile
description: Declarative capability profile for a tool-definition CONSUMER — an LLM-provider tool-use API (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, ...) or an MCP host (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ...). mcpconform is provider-agnostic: every consumer, including the MCP spec itself, is described by one of these files. No vendor is privileged in the engine; the generic provider/* rule family reads whichever profile(s) the run targets.

kind.description: synthetic = a computed intersection (e.g. generic-strict). spec-baseline = an MCP spec revision modelled as a profile.

verified.description: true ONLY when every constraint below was read from the consumer's own documentation (cited in `source`). Findings that rely on a verified:false profile are flagged by meta/profile-unverified so a guessed number never reads as gospel.

source.description: URL(s) of the doc the constraints came from. Required when verified=true.

pattern.description: ECMA regex the full tool name must match.

caseSensitive.description: false = the consumer matches tool names case-insensitively, so names that differ only by case collide (provider/name-case-collision).

maxCount.description: Max number of tool definitions accepted in one request.

maxTotalBytes.description: Budget on the serialized tool set, if the consumer documents one.

rootMustBeObject.description: Deprecated and ignored: the MCP spec already requires an object root, which the core rule tool/input-schema-root-object enforces for every target. Accepted only so existing custom profiles still validate.

supportedKeywords.description: ALLOWLIST. If present, any JSON-Schema keyword NOT in this list is treated as unsupported. Use for allowlist consumers like Gemini's OpenAPI subset.

unsupportedKeywords.description: DENYLIST of keywords the consumer rejects (error).

unenforcedKeywords.description: Constraint keywords accepted but not applied (won't constrain model output) — flagged at info by default, promoted to error when a strict mode rejects them.

ignoredKeywords.description: Keywords the consumer silently drops with no error (e.g. additionalProperties/default on Gemini). Flagged at info, never error — distinguishes 'harmlessly ignored' from 'rejected'.

supportedStringFormats.description: `format` values the consumer honors in strict mode. When strict.rejectsUnenforcedKeywords is true, `format` with one of these values is accepted in strict mode and any other value is rejected (provider/schema-unsupported-keyword). Default mode is unaffected.

allowsRecursion.description: false = recursive schemas (a $ref to "#", $dynamicRef/$recursiveRef, or a cycle among local $defs) are rejected (provider/schema-no-refs). Checked only when allowsRefs is not false — without $ref there is no recursion.

maxProperties.description: Max total object properties, summed over every object in the schema (provider/schema-max-properties).

strict.description: Extra constraints that apply ONLY when the consumer's strict / structured-output mode is enabled for this target (config: mode='strict').

maxProperties.description: Strict-mode max total object properties, summed over every object in the schema (provider/schema-max-properties).
